summary: SUP-1008 (Shakti Components Pvt Ltd) experienced a Line 2 fire on 2026-12-02, halting production for an expected 48 hours. PO-1001 (4000 units of ITM-501, due 2026-12-03) and PO-1002 (2500 units of ITM-501, due 2026-12-04) are affected, with total exposure of INR 491400.00. Current inventory provides 1.5 days of coverage, and both POs will cause shortages. The biggest unknown is SUP-1008's remaining production capacity during the outage and the actual restart date.
